description: Out of work position refers to needles placed in the A position, where they will not knit - regardless of the carriage settings. Yarn is not laid into these needles, and no stitches are formed.
tooltip: Needles that are in "A" position and will not knit no matter what the carriage setting.
example: Create an eyelet by transferring a stitch to it's neighbor and putting the emptied needle into out of work position.

schemaMarkup.name: Out of Work Position
schemaMarkup.description: A machine knitting needle position where needles are placed in the A position and will not knit, regardless of carriage settings. Also referred to as non-working position or needles out of work.
